author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a three-point crown over a face with a mouth line and a rounded beard, wavy hair strands at both sides and a shoulder line; reads as a crowned, bearded Triton bust. Two earlier candidates with closed hair lobes read as a crowned bag and were discarded. The rejected drawing was a tangle of lines.
omissions: The hairline waves, eye and the curved shoulders are simplified (straight shoulder line); hair is drawn as two strands instead of full wavy masses.
drawing_plan: SQUARE symmetric about x 24: crown band y 18 (x 10..38) with points at y 6 and valleys (17,11)/(31,11); face sides x 16/32 from 18 to 26; mouth y 26; beard half-ellipse 8x7; hair strands from (10,18)/(38,18) to (6,34)/(42,34); shoulders y 42.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'crown' for the crown; bust composition.
